newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SingTel says no talk with Telkom.
newsitem.headline: SingTel says no talk with Telkom.

text.p: Singapore Telecommunications Ltd (SingTel) has held no discussions with PT Telekommunikasi Indonesia (Telkom) about SingTel possibly taking a stake in Telkom, SingTel's chairman said on Friday.

Asked about rumours it would buy into Telkom, SingTel chairman Koh Boon Hwee told reporters: "We can definitely say that Singapore Telecom has held no discussions with PT Telkom at this point in time."
He added, however, that the group was looking at investment opportunities in the Asia Pacific region, including Indonesia and China.
Koh was speaking at a briefing on SingTel's annual results.
